summary_en: This study tests STX-721/PFL-721 in adults with non-small cell lung cancer that has an EGFR or HER2 exon 20 insertion mutation. The route of administration, and how often and how long it is given, are not stated; doses are escalated in some parts, and some parts give it with platinum-based chemotherapy. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic exposure, and preliminary antitumor activity, and it is a Phase 1/2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa STX-721/PFL-721 en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que tiene una mutación de inserción en el exón 20 de EGFR o HER2. La vía de administración, y con qué frecuencia y durante cuánto tiempo se administra, no se indica; en algunas partes del estudio las dosis se aumentan y en otras se combina con quimioterapia basada en platino. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la exposición farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral preliminar, y es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Stage IIIB/C or IV non-small cell lung cancer not eligible for curative surgery or chemoradiation
Tumor has an EGFR or HER2 exon 20 insertion mutation confirmed by a qualified local lab
Prior treatment limits: Part 1 requires all approved therapies or ineligibility; Parts 2 and 3 require 1 to 2 prior lines, one platinum-based unless contraindic
Documented tumor progression on imaging with at least one measurable lesion
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Tumor known to have the EGFR exon 20 insertion H773_V774insH variant
EGFR kinase activating mutation together with T790M and/or C797S resistance mutation
Another cancer, different from lung cancer, diagnosed within 2 years before screening
Unresolved toxicities from prior cancer therapy above grade 1, except alopecia and peripheral neuropathy
